title: Luffa aegyptiaca Mill. — Plants of the World Online
scope: Accepted species identity and synonym relationship; no cultivation claims

title: Luffa — Florida Vegetable Gardening Guide (HS1285)
scope: Florida outdoor crop guidance for smooth luffa; seed establishment, vine management, containers, flower/pollinator observations, young-fruit food use, mature fibrous fruit stage and problems; its separate ball-luffa sponge example is not assigned to Luffa aegyptiaca; not evidence for indoor hydroponic performance or a named cultivar

title: Tetragonia tetragonoides (Pall.) Kuntze — Plants of the World Online
scope: Accepted species identity and synonym relationship, including Tetragonia expansa; no cultivation claims

title: New Zealand Spinach in the Garden
scope: Species-level home-garden guidance for Tetragonia tetragonoides; seed handling, establishment, spreading habit, adult harvest/food preparation and regional growing context; not true spinach or a household-system validation

publisher: Horticulturae (MDPI); University of Palermo research team
title: Effects of Hydroponic Cultivation on Baby Plant Characteristics of Tetragonia tetragonioides (Pallas) O. Kunze at Harvest and During Storage as Minimally Processed Produce
scope: Peer-reviewed two-season greenhouse study of hydroponic baby-plant production for Tetragonia tetragonoides; supports this limited production stage and experimental context only, not mature-plant performance, household appliance compatibility, or transferable nutrient targets

title: Zea mays L. — Plants of the World Online
scope: Accepted species identity and botanical context; sweet-corn type and cultivation supported by Extension sources

title: Sweet Corn in the Garden
scope: Utah home-garden sweet corn guidance; block planting, crop care and harvest context; no named cultivar assigned

title: Sweet Corn — Vegetable Guide: Harvest and Handling
scope: Crop-level sweet-corn maturity at milk stage, harvest cues, hand-harvest technique and postharvest quality in Utah production context; not cultivar-specific calendar or indoor growing guidance

title: Sweet Corn — Vegetable Guide: Planting
scope: Sweet-corn planting and soil-temperature guidance in Utah production context; genotype and seed treatment affect cold-soil response

title: Growing sweet corn in home gardens
scope: Home-garden sweet corn guidance for Minnesota; untreated seed soil temperature, block planting, pollination and harvest; regional recommendations, not cultivar-specific
